study type: Secondary analysis of a multicenter randomized controlled trial cohort (cross-sectional assessment at 3-year follow-up)
outcome: Symptoms of CSDi (chronic pelvic pain, postmenstrual spotting, abnormal vaginal discharge)
cohort: Participants were patients aged 18 years or older who had undergone a first cesarean section, originally enrolled from 32 hospitals in the Netherlands for the 2Close study.
finding: The prevalence of Cesarean Scar Disorder (CSDi) 3 years following a first cesarean section was found to be 42.5% (285/670).
mod_finding: The study found a high prevalence of Cesarean Scar Disorder (CSDi) at 42.5% 3 years after a first cesarean section.
